prompts.name: live-shop
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the referenced pixel-art storefront. Create its abandoned, aged, slightly broken counterpart for HoloCrawl's distorted backstage city. Keep cyan/pink slash logo recognizable but one slash partially unlit. One glass door has a missing pane and slightly bent lower frame. Canopy chipped.
